correctness.rationale: The ordinary matching complex of the 3-by-10 vertex grid has 47 graph edges. Source verify_grid10.cpp exhaustively branches on each edge, removing incidences, and its greedy early-edge toggle has the usual acyclic alternating-path argument. Two complete, independent stored GF(2) critical-cell boundary matrices were read as actual source blobs, parsed and independently row-reduced with exact BigInt bitset elimination: ascending 122x393 rank120; descending 30x301 rank28; no malformed rows. Thus reduced H10 has dimension 2 and H9 dimension 273 in both matchings, with no other critical degrees. Independently, an edge-state matching DP counted 47,177,097 augmented faces and Euler sum 271, consistent with -273+2=-271. The finite certificate supports exactly P3-square-P10 mod-two homology; it proves neither integral freeness nor any larger width.
residual_risks: The 47,177,097-face C++ regeneration was inspected but not rerun end-to-end locally because of its 1GB resource requirements; the stored exact matrix rank and independent face count are not independent matrix-generation certificates.
